thimblefen_cottage.name: Thimblefen Kulübesi

pebblewake_porch.name: Pebblewake Verandası

brinebeam_wreck.name: Brinebeam Batığı

polypocket_reef.name: Polypocket Resifi

blushbutton_nook.name: Blushbutton Köşesi

gilded_acorn_court.name: Altın Meşe Palamudu Avlusu

slategill_bathhouse.name: Slategill Hamamı

tilebud_courtyard.name: Tilebud Avlusu

glimmerpip_midway.name: Glimmerpip Panayırı
